messages:
Maria G: Hey — I legally changed my last name this week and updated AD, but my insurer still has my old last name. My OB office says the member ID they have shows the previous name and they're refusing to check me in for a procedure tomorrow. Can people ops issue an updated ID card or an official coverage/identity letter same-day? :pleading_face:

Jamie (People Ops): Sorry you're dealing with that, Maria. We can usually get a temporary coverage letter same-day and start the carrier name-change process. Quick Qs: do you have the marriage certificate scan and the member ID number? Also did you update your name in the benefits portal or via HR ticket?

Maria G: I updated AD and payroll but I don't think I clicked anything in the benefits portal. I have a PDF of the marriage certificate and my old insurance card (member ID: X123456789). Appointment is at 9:30am tomorrow.

Lisa - Benefits: We can help. Policy summary:
- Carrier requires a name-change request + proof (marriage certificate or court order) to reissue physical ID cards — that can take 5–10 business days.
- We can generate an official "Proof of Coverage / Name Affidavit" letter the same day if you email docs to benefits@redwood.com with the subject exactly: `NAME CHANGE - Maria G - URGENT`.

Please include in the email: attachment of the marriage certificate, a photo/scan of the old insurance card, and the full member ID + DOB. We'll reply with a signed PDF letter you can present to the clinic.

Lisa - Benefits: Example email body you can paste:```
Subject: NAME CHANGE - Maria G - URGENT
To: benefits@redwood.com

Hi Benefits team,
My details: Maria Gonzalez (new last name: Martinez), member ID X123456789, DOB 1990-05-12. Attached: marriage_certificate.pdf, old_card.jpg. I need a signed proof of coverage and name-change support letter for an OB appointment at [Clinic Name] on 2026-03-25. Please expedite.
Thanks,
Maria
```

BenefitsBot: ✅ Ticket created: #BEN-4527 — "Name change / request for temporary proof". An HR benefits rep will respond by EOD. If you emailed attachments, please confirm receipt here.

Maria G: Thanks — just sent the email with attachments. Reply from benefits would be amazing, panic level: low-to-medium. :sweat_smile:

Jamie (People Ops): Confirmed — I see ticket BEN-4527 in the queue and Lisa is assigned. If the clinic still insists, we can also provide a signed letter on company letterhead confirming active coverage while carrier processes the name change. That letter will list the member ID and plan name but not include SSN.

Lisa - Benefits: Got the email + attachments. We're issuing the signed temporary coverage letter now and will upload the carrier name-change request on your behalf. Expect the PDF in ~30–60 minutes. If the carrier asks, we may need a signed authorization form — I'll DM you if that's needed. :white_check_mark:

Maria G: You are lifesavers, thank you!!!
